ICU REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2601

CURRENT PHYSIOLOGIC RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2601
RASS values over the past hour are -4, -4, and -3. Mean arterial pressure fell from 76 to 59 mmHg. The patient remains ventilator-synchronous.

ACTIVE ORDER
Propofol infusion is ordered at 5–50 mcg/kg/min. The administration record shows a current rate of 38 mcg/kg/min. No revised sedation target is documented.

MEDICATION EVIDENCE
Fentanyl infusion was increased 30 minutes ago. A nursing note records no new painful procedure. Vasopressor support is unchanged. The most recent physician note predates the blood-pressure decline.
